svg.title: The attach contract: a first arming draws the fleet, a re-arm prints only what moved
svg.desc: Two panes side by side. On the left, a first arming for a session with three live runs and no checkpoint opens with one baseline row per live run. On the right, a re-arm continues from where the previous arming stopped: with nothing new it prints nothing, and when one run moves it prints only that run's transition. A crew live read is the way to ask for the current fleet at any time.

g.text: Attaching: the first arming draws the fleet, a re-arm prints what moved
A session's first arm has no checkpoint to continue, so it opens with the fleet as it stands. Every later arm continues.
One line per live run, so a reader attaching for the first
time sees the fleet before the first transition arrives.
re-arm — continues from where it stopped
(only what moved since the last arming)
The checkpoint names the runs this reader was already
shown, so an unchanged run is silent — never replayed.
Ask for the current fleet with a live read.
nothing new → 0 rows · one move → 1 row
